context: Pick the Charm stack for a new tool

checklist.name: right_libraries
checklist.description: Recommends Huh for the questionnaire, Bubble Tea plus Bubbles (table, viewport) for the dashboard, Lip Gloss for styling, and Log for logging.

checklist.name: charm_land_paths
checklist.description: Uses the v2 `charm.land/<name>/v2` module paths (bubbletea, bubbles, lipgloss, huh, log), not `github.com/charmbracelet/<name>`.

checklist.name: no_mixed_majors
checklist.description: Does not mix v1 and v2 modules of the same library.

checklist.name: explains_fit
checklist.description: Explains briefly how the pieces hand data to each other (for example a Huh form embedded in Bubble Tea, Lip Gloss styles in views).
